primitives.name: Air Density and Wind Impact
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.2513 kg/m3 measured at Bank of America Stadium [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-18/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 8.8 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d': 'distance shift in meters', 'ρ': 'air density in kg/m³', 'v_wind': 'wind velocity in km/h'}
primitives.assumptions: Standardized ball dynamics model with linear dependence on air density and wind speed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \rho > 1.293 \) kg/m³ or \( v_{\text{wind}} > 15 \) km/h, deviation from sea-level model exceeds 2%.
